profile.summary: Quattrocchi Kwok Architects (QKA) is an architecture firm that designs school buildings and campuses. It provides master planning, design and construction administration services, mainly for K-12 schools and higher education in Northern California. It has offices in Santa Rosa and Oakland, California, and in Colorado.
